bullets.text: AI Dev Days Announced - Join Microsoft for a two-day virtual event on December 10-11 focused on AI innovations.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New build 26220.7344 introduces native support for MCP, enhancing AI agent connectivity.
Microsoft Leads Email Security - Recognized as a leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Email Security.
Microsoft 365 Updates - New AI and security capabilities announced for Microsoft 365, with pricing changes effective July 2026.
Copilot Business Launch - Microsoft 365 Copilot Business now available, integrating AI into everyday tasks for small businesses.
